fieldDefinitions.label: Income tax
fieldDefinitions.description: Income tax withheld from gross monthly compensation.

fieldDefinitions.label: Payroll and social deductions
fieldDefinitions.description: Mandatory payroll, social insurance, or similar non-saving deductions.

fieldDefinitions.label: Other cash deductions
fieldDefinitions.description: Other deductions that reduce take-home cash and are not investments.

fieldDefinitions.label: Payroll retirement or pension saving
fieldDefinitions.description: Automatic saving deducted from gross pay; counted as investment, not expense.

fieldDefinitions.label: Housing
fieldDefinitions.description: Rent, mortgage interest, maintenance, or housing charges for this option.

fieldDefinitions.label: Internet and mobile
fieldDefinitions.description: Home internet and household mobile plans.

fieldDefinitions.label: Groceries and household
fieldDefinitions.description: Food, household supplies, and routine purchases.

fieldDefinitions.label: Transport
fieldDefinitions.description: Public transport, fuel, insurance, parking, and routine travel.

fieldDefinitions.label: Childcare and education
fieldDefinitions.description: Childcare, school, and recurring education costs.

fieldDefinitions.label: Healthcare and insurance
fieldDefinitions.description: Medicines, health costs, and personal insurance paid from take-home cash.

fieldDefinitions.label: Dining, leisure and other
fieldDefinitions.description: Dining, drinks, recreation, clothing, and other routine spending.

fieldDefinitions.label: Debt repayments
fieldDefinitions.description: Loans or repayments that continue in every option.

fieldDefinitions.label: Family support or remittances paid
fieldDefinitions.description: Outgoing family costs that remain your responsibility in every option.

fieldDefinitions.label: Other shared commitments
fieldDefinitions.description: Other recurring obligations applied equally to every option.

fieldDefinitions.label: Market investments
fieldDefinitions.description: Planned post-tax investing applied equally to every option.

fieldDefinitions.label: Other planned investment
fieldDefinitions.description: Other planned saving or investment applied equally to every option.

scenarios.label: New option
scenarios.bonus: Not included until converted into recurring monthly inputs.
